text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: While Super Creek and I are talking<n>about training...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Gosh, I'm sorry. Did I startle you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're such a kind soul. I'm<n>fine.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I have a bit of a headache, but I'm<n>sure I'll be right
as rain in no time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So no need to worry, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, she appears<n>to be in pain. I
should probably keep<n>an eye on her.
